notes: Updating your CANBUS Speed If you are trying to modify the speed of your existing CAN network then there is an order of operations to make it as seamless as possible.
UNLESS YOU ARE CHANGING YOUR CANBUS SPEED YOU DON’T NEED TO USE THESE STEPS.

Your toolhead should still boot into Klipper firmware fine at this stage(still with the old firmware) Force the toolhead back into Katapult mode, either with a double-click of the reset button or with python3 ~/katapult/scripts/flashtool.py -i can0 -u yourtoolheaduuid -r Temporarily change your CAN network speed by run
Note that you do not need to reflash the katapult on your mainboard as this Katapult talks to the Pi over USB and so doesn’t care what the CANBUS speed is set to.

notes: Updating Katapult Updating Katapult isn’t something you should need to do regularly, if at all.
If Katapult is currently working on your board (toolhead or mainboard or other) then just leave it as is.
The only time you should really need to update Katapult is if you are changing CAN speeds, and even then that’s only on the toolhead.
If you need to do this please refer to Updating CAN Speed You should never really have to update your Katapult on the mainboard.
